mapper.insert: insert into reservation ( user_id, charger_id, reservation_type, status, car_type, reserved_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{chargerId}, #{reservationType}, 'RESERVED', #{carType}, now() )
mapper.select:
select r.id, r.user_id as userId, r.charger_id as chargerId, r.reservation_type as reservationType, r.status, r.car_type as carType, r.reserved_at as reservedAt, r.actual_start_time as actualStartTime, r.actual_end_time as actualEndTime,
rt.start_time as startTime, rt.end_time as endTime,
tgt.target_kwh as targetKwh, tgt.max_minutes as maxMinutes
from reservation r
left join reservation_time rt on r.id = rt.reservation_id
left join reservation_target tgt on r.id = tgt.reservation_id
where r.id = #{reservationId}

select r.id, r.user_id as userId, r.charger_id as chargerId, r.reservation_type as reservationType, r.status, r.car_type as carType, r.reserved_at as reservedAt,
rt.start_time as startTime, rt.end_time as endTime,
tgt.target_kwh as targetKwh, tgt.max_minutes as maxMinutes
from reservation r
left join reservation_time rt on r.id = rt.reservation_id
left join reservation_target tgt on r.id = tgt.reservation_id
where r.user_id = #{userId}
order by r.id desc
mapper.update: update reservation set status = 'COMPLETED', actual_end_time = now() where id = #{reservationId}

update reservation r join reservation_time rt on r.id = rt.reservation_id
set r.status = 'EXPIRED'
where r.status = 'RESERVED'
and rt.end_time < now()
mapper.select: select id, station_id as stationId, connector_type as connectorType, power_kw as powerKw, status from charger order by id asc

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(rt.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS startTime, DATE_FORMAT(rt.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS endTime FROM reservation r JOIN reservation_time rt ON r.id = rt.reservation_id WHERE r.charger_id = #{chargerId} AND DATE(rt.start_time) = #{date} AND r.reservation_type = 'TIME' AND r.status = 'RESERVED'
